subject: Your friend needs this 3AM tool
preview_text: One person in your life is making the same mistake you almost made. Send them this.
body_paragraphs: Remember that 3AM panic when you almost revenge traded after a bad call? You had the app. You didn't use it. You almost blew it. But someone in your life is making that same mistake right now, without this safety net.

Think about it — that friend who always FOMOs into coins at 2x leverage, or the one who sells every dip at a loss because Twitter told them to. They don't have the calm voice of Predictify Coach or the cold data of our multi-source signal stack. They're drowning in noise, just like you were.

You already know the app works. Your trading journal proves it — higher accuracy, fewer impulse trades. Now imagine handing someone else that edge. The share feature in your profile lets you send a 7-day free trial instantly. They get institutional-grade analysis. You get the quiet satisfaction of being the one who saved them from a 3AM disaster.
Open the app now, tap 'Share with a friend' in your profile, and pick the person who needs this most. P.S. — The AI confidence meter just spotted a setup on your watchlist. Check it before you share.
